_doc: JAMES UPSHALL dating cabinet (#54, Wave F, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #17). The Charatan diaspora house: 1978, Tilshead (Wiltshire) — Barry Jones (Charatan's master carver, our artisan registry) + Major Kenneth Barnes (Charatan's ex-MD) + son Kennedy Barnes. Named for the Major's ancestor James Archelaus Upshall. TILSHEAD = the briar-flaw second line (same make). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/James_Upshall.json (company text + the 1984 pamphlet scans + Barnes radio interviews referenced) + artisan registry (barry-jones: Charatan 1955-77 -> Tilshead 1978-2010).

history_anchors._doc: 1978: founded at Tilshead, Wiltshire. Barry Jones: from age 15 at Charatan (personally guided by Reuben Charatan; responsible for most famous Charatan shapes — charatan.json link); Kennedy Barnes also ex-Charatan (father = MD before the Dunhill sale). Hand-turned on flat-bed lathes, NO copy-fraisers; naturally-dried Greek plateau; NO fills/putty on Upshall-stamped pipes (flawed bowls -> TILSHEAD). Grading: finishes bark/sandblast/black dress/smooth; root-quality ladder S (mahogany red) < A (chestnut tan) < P (walnut, straighter grain); straight-grain high grades B < G < E < X < XX (XX ≈ 1% of production); EMPIRE SERIES = limited giant pieces. 1984: leatherette catalog (scans in mirror; note: S-grade RED stain 'must have come later' than 1984 — pamphlet-era S = other colors). Fishing pipes w/ lanyard rings + UNBOXED logo exist (1984 pamphlet). Silver/gold banding program (6/10mm, 9ct/18ct, spigot + army mounts). Celebrity roster lore (King Hussein, Sadat, Crosby...). April 2021: Ken(nedy) Barnes dies unexpectedly (had restarted limited making in Cornwall). Production continued under later ownership (Ezrati contact era).

table.label: JAMES UPSHALL marking = 1978+ (Tilshead founding: Barry Jones + Kenneth/Kennedy Barnes, ex-Charatan)
TILSHEAD marking (second line / location stamp) = 1978+ (same founding floor)
JU logo on the mouthpiece = 1996+ (vkpipes: stem logos introduced 1996; before that stems were bare -- absence never dates)
pantograph-ENGRAVED stampings = 1984+ (vkpipes: engraving began 1984; earlier stamps conventional -- describe engraving as 'pantograph' in lettering evidence)

L-series stamp (L2/L3/L4 = shank length, longest L4) = 1985+ (Pete Siegel, US distributor + series creator, via rebornpipes 2024-09-27: first 'few dozen made in 1986', article brackets earliest 1985-86; digits after = shank cm x10, e.g. 95 = 9.5cm; L series launched all P-grade + length surcharge)

★'78' YEAR STAMP = EXACTLY 1978, first year ONLY (Ken Barnes verbatim, PipesMag ep178 interview 2016-02-09 @40:50: 'did you continue stamping the years?' -> 'No, we did only 1978' + @37:32 'if you want a really rare Upshall look for one with the 78 stamp... it's from the first year'.
